notes.note: Bounded Linux lifecycle repair review: node-pty beta.17 bundles Linux prebuilds, so the old directory-only supplier probe skipped the source build required by the empty reviewed manifest. The managed hook runner now supplies npm_config_build_from_source=true only for Linux node-pty/node-pty-smoke targets absent from that manifest; the parent environment, pinned channel, other packages, confinement, integrity, artifact verification and gallery refusal remain intact. Policy parsing stays outside the degradable build catch. Updated the canonical dependency guide and channel README; command ownership, permission/API contracts and governance instructions need no prose change. On an isolated Linux x64 host using the repo-pinned Node24.21.0 distribution, the clean baseline managed install reproduced DEGRADED, and the test-only source case failed at the missing compiled-artifact assertion (121 passed/1 failed). The repair passed managed install and verify with real PTY handshakes and zero degraded lines, plus 148 focused lifecycle/docs/adapter tests (5 Windows-only excluded). Mac owners passed 120 tests with 3 Linux-only cases excluded; script typechecking and lint passed. Independent source-only review found no blocker and did not borrow runtime receipts. This does not claim hosted gallery/pixel, Linux ARM64, installed-shell or release qualification; prior broader reviews remain revision-scoped.
